question: Why does program check report 4.4 GB but du -sh reports 9.7 GB?
answer: program check sums cost_actual.disk_gb from experiment outcomes in ledger/experiments.jsonl. Most experiments (67 of 73 with outcomes) recorded disk_gb as 0 because the field was not tracked before about Nov 16. The gap has three parts.

experiments_without_outcome.note: Running or dead but not yet collected

pre_runs_data.note: Reference data, worktrees, checker, figures, map — not tracked by experiments
